links.effect: No significant DVH differences among manual, adjusted AC and unadjusted AC (all p>0.05); CTV Dmean difference -58.7 cGy (p=0.077) for unadjusted AC; differences <1% of prescription; underpowered (n=15).
links.quote: No statistically significant differences were observed among the three groups in any dose volume histogram parameters.

links.outcome: Effect of adjusting AI seminal vesicle contours to institutional guideline on dose agreement with manual
links.effect: Adjusted AC gave distributions closer to manual contouring; effect sizes g=0.53-0.63 versus g=0.67-0.78 for unadjusted AC; none statistically significant.
links.quote: The adjusted AC group showed distribution characteristics closer to those of the MC group, supporting the effectiveness of SV area adjustment.

links.outcome: Local retrospective performance of AI contours against manual reference using predefined clinical acceptability criteria
links.effect: All differences within predefined tolerance (±5% dose, ±2% V95%); CTV Dmean differences -41.3 to -58.7 cGy (0.5-0.8% of prescription); no significant differences, but small sample and no equivalence margins.
links.quote: Our criteria for clinically acceptable differences were set as follows: 1) PTV/CTV dose parameters: differences within ±5%, and 2) PTV V95%: differences within ±2%.
